title: Communities
tagline: Developer groups, FOSS, and tech forums
description: Nepal's developer community spans national FOSS groups (FOSS Nepal, Open Knowledge Nepal, opensource-nepal), university clubs (LOCUS, KUCC), GDG/Microsoft chapters, women-in-tech orgs (WLiT), and recurring hackathons (Yantra, NASA Space Apps Kathmandu).
